entities.summary: Julia Demina was a Russian chess player. She has won the Women's Russian Chess Championship twice, the Soviet championship once before, and competed for the Women's World Chess Championship several times. Demina earned the title of Woman Grandmaster in 1991. She died in November 2025, at the age of 56.
